FX-HALO-001.says: Halation as added (threshold 60, smooth 50, amount 100, red-orange #ff4020), radius 12: the yellow patch, the only light bright enough, gets a red-orange halo round it, strongest at its edge; the yellow itself is untouched.

FX-HALO-002.says: Threshold 0: every pixel's light counts, so each patch spreads onto anything darker beside it: halation round all three patches and on the darker patches' near edges.

FX-HALO-003.says: Radius 0: nothing spreads, so there is no halation: the drawing as it is.

FX-HALO-004.says: Radius 100: the halation spread wide and faint.

FX-HALO-005.says: Amount 300: three times as strong as FX-HALO-001 off the drawing.

FX-HALO-006.says: Amount 0: no halation: the drawing as it is.

FX-HALO-007.says: Colour white: the same halo, colourless.

FX-HALO-008.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 200 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-HALO-001.

FX-HALO-009.says: The grey drawing: the grey patch is bright enough to give some halation too.

FX-HALO-010.says: The patches half covering: the light counts at half, and the halation outside the drawing covers by its brightest channel.

FX-HALO-011.says: Moved three pixels right: the halation follows, and none is cut off at the layer's edge.

FX-HALO-012.says: Threshold 30, smooth 0: a hard step: the yellow glows fully and nothing else.

FX-HALO-013.says: Radius 2.25: one level, half in: a thin halo one pixel wide.

FX-HALO-014.says: Threshold 90, smooth 50: the yellow only partly bright enough, a weaker halo.

FX-HALO-015.says: Threshold 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HALO-016.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HALO-017.says: Colour "orange", not a colour #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HALO-018.says: Amount keyed to 500 at frame 4, above 400. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
